senses.gloss: (b. h.) to glisten (cmp. דנח) to be fat; to be greasy, foul (cmp. meanings of זהם, צחן, v. Ges. Thes. s. v. זנח);

units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 60:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. LX</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 777:5">Yalk. Ps. 777</cite> <he>אני זָנַחְתִּי אתכם אתם זְנַחְתֶּם אותי</he> did I loathe you? You loathed me.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 41:1">Pesik. R. s. 41</cite> (ref. to <he>זונה</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 73:27">Ps. LXXIII, 27</cite>) <he>שרחקו וזָנְחוּ הימך</he> because they removed themselves from and were loth of Thee.

senses.gloss: to declare rejectable, unclean; (cmp. זהם) to reject; (cmp. סאב, רחק) to remove.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 7a:2">Ḥull. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>אין מַזְנִיחִין אותו</he> we must not detest him (remove him from college). Pesik. R. l. c. <he>מַזְנִיחִים עצמם הימך</he> they (through their sins) remove themselves from thee.

senses.gloss: to polish, cleanse. Lev. R. s. l, beg. (ref. to אבי זנוח) I Chr. IV, 18) that is Moses שהיה אב למַזְנִיחִים שהִזְנִיחָם מע״ז for he was the father of the cleaners, for he cleansed them from idolatry; Yalk. ib. 428.

units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20">Num. R. s. 20</cite>; Tanḥ. Balak 12 <he>באתי</he> … <he>זִנַּחְתִּיהָ</he> I had come to kill her, and now I had to polish her up; (Tanḥ. ed. Bub. ib. 20 <he>זיניתה</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 768">Yalk. Num. 768</cite>, Matt. K. to Num. R. l. c. quotes in Tanḥ. l. c. <he>דכיתיה</he>).
